en: Self-hosted runner: Fixed Claude not seeing the interrupted tool call when a session moves to a new runner and the turn is older than `CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_INTERRUPTED_TURN_MAX_AGE_MS`
zh: 自托管 runner：修复了当 session 迁移到新 runner 且该轮次早于 `CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_INTERRUPTED_TURN_MAX_AGE_MS` 时，Claude 看不到被中断的工具调用的问题
